text:
susan: Hey team — starting a thread to kick off a small sprint to create the Galaxy Marketplace starter templates and Terraform modules. Goal: one opinionated refarch + modular TF modules (network, nodes, inference, monitoring) that partners can fork. Want to land an initial repo and a smoke CI by EOW. Thoughts?
raj: love it. can we make modules composable so partners can swap out storage/kv?
marco: yes — design should be interface-first. propose repo: github.com/redwood-inference/galaxy-marketplace-starters. owners: @marco + @susan initially.
olivia: heads-up: market reqs need ARM64/Graviton + Ampere notes. we should include simple perf guidance and a quantization note.
susan: agree. i'll draft an ownership doc and a checklist. checklist items: repo scaffold, module API, README quickstart, example app, smoke CI, marketplace packaging notes, licence and security checklist.
raj: for smoke CI, we can use a lightweight GH action that runs `terraform init && terraform plan` against a tiny mock provider or localstack. cc @ci-bot to suggest workflow.
ci-bot: suggested-workflow: .github/workflows/smoke.yml -> runs on PR, uses hashicorp/setup-terraform @v1, runs `terraform fmt`, `terraform validate`, `terraform init -backend=false`, `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan`, uploads plan artifact.
marco: sample module API idea: module "inference_pool" { source = "./modules/inference" model = "<model-id>" replicas = 2 instance_type = "g5" }
marco: include a `profiles/` dir with small/medium/large reference config and cost/latency tradeoffs.
olivia: packaging: add a section for marketplace metadata + cloud partner reqs (support matrix, region notes, compliance pointers). i'll write the first draft.
susan: pairing request: @raj and @marco can you prototype the `modules/network` and `modules/inference` by Wed? i'll wire up the repo and PR template.
raj: can do. will add Terraform 1.5 compat and mention `required_providers` pins.
marco: i'll add examples for Ampere and Graviton instance types and a small benchmark script `bench/run.sh` that runs a 1000-token inference loop against local dev runtime.
susan: one more ask — include a simple `cdk`/pulumi example? or keep TF-only for now?
olivia: keep TF-first. we can add other SDK examples in a follow-up. need to get marketplace listing approved first.
marco: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/galaxy-marketplace-starters/pull/1 - initial scaffold + module stubs. please review.
raj: quick review incoming. saw `backend=false` in CI — good. also add `terraform lock` mechanism for reproducible providers.
susan: noted. once PR is green we'll cut a release candidate and hand off to partner enablement for validation. tagging product for joint announcement planning later.
olivia: timeline: prototype by Wed, CI green by Thu, partner smoke validation Fri. ok?
raj: ok for me.
marco: ok.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview: created preview env galaxy-starter-pr-1. URL: https://preview.redwood-inference.test/galaxy-pr-1 :rocket:
susan: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a short RFC doc and assign tasks in the repo issues. :thumbsup:
